results.title: Frustrating Bug with Buddy List Groups - Official MapleStory Website
results.content:
I believe this bug appeared after some QoL changes were made to the UI. This is quite frustrating as you'll have to expand your Default Group to see who is online every time you open your buddy list. You can work around this by placing all your friends into a newly created group. If this bug occurs to a group that isn't the Default Group, I found that right-clicking that group, selecting edit and selecting ok afterwards will fix it. This work around does not work with the Default Group as you cannot edit or modify the Default Group.  
   
 Character name: Tummy  
   
 Character level: 234  
   
 Character job: Night Lord  
   
 World name: Reboot  
   
 Date and time of the incident: 5:46 a.m. Friday, March 9, 2018 (EST) [...] Bug type: UI Functionality  
   
 Brief bug summary: If you hide the default group in your buddy list, every time you open your buddy list it will be hidden even if you expanded it before closing it.  
   
 More details: You can click on the default group to hide people online on your buddy list. If you click it again, it'll expand the list and show everyone that is currently online.  
   
 Steps to reproduce: Open Buddy List ==> Click on the GREY BAR labled "Default Group" (XX/XX) ==> Close Buddy List ==> Repeat Steps 1 & 2 ==> Observed Result is that the Default Group will continue to be hidden, even if you previously expanded it before closing. results.title: Common problems and solutions
results.content:
As of 2014, Google's XMPP support has become somewhat broken. The messages you send to `gmail.com` contacts using XMPP are never delivered and Google never gives any feedback to indicate there was a problem. You continue to see the contact's status changes in your buddy list, giving no clue that the Google service is broken.

Until the Google issues are resolved, suggest to your contacts that they revert their Google account to use Google Talk instead of Hangouts. Google provides a link for this: ` The XMPP Foundation maintains a  list of hosting companies who provide fully functional XMPP support.

### Audio and video quality issues [...] | Common problems and solutions |

## Common problems and solutions

### Google Talk/Hangouts users not receiving XMPP chat messages

If you have been using XMPP for a long time, you may well have some friends in your buddy list who are using `gmail.com` addresses. In the beginning, Google largely supported XMPP (with some limitations to TLS support) and it was possible to add `gmail.com` users to the buddy list and communicate with them using IM, voice and video.

results.title: What's new in buddylist: the changelog
results.content:
buddylist says when a newer version is out and downloads it for you.
 Help > Send feedback for feedback, bug reports and feature requests.
 Faster history search, smoother streaming of long replies, and fixes for crashes, lost replies and settings that could be wiped.
 Agent Messenger is now buddylist, at buddylist.dev. Your contacts and conversations move over the first time you open it. [...] Smoother long conversations — Streaming replies, message history and background output do less repeated work as conversations grow. History also avoids listing another chat tab's session twice.
 Smaller fixes — Double-clicking Send no longer immediately stops the turn, pasting several pictures includes them all, editing a message keeps the draft's file attachments, and stopping Codex while it connects prevents the waiting message from being sent. Markdown images fit inside messages, All files has file context menus, and invitations offer the supported agents. [...] Hand a failed check to the agent — Under a failed check in the Checks tab, Send to Claude says it in the conversation, with why it failed and its page on GitHub, for the agent to fix. In a group conversation it goes to the agent whose branch it is, and the check's row says Sent.
 Suggested replies in a card — The replies offered under a question sit in a card of their own, headed Suggested replies, so they stand out from the lines around them.
 Your limits from the start — The Session and Weekly bars show in every conversation as soon as it opens, from what any conversation on the same login last reported, also after a restart.
 Smaller fixes — Delete all contacts... and Remove project... list the contacts they delete one under the other, in a box that scrolls when there are many.
